ask_text: Publish your emergency admission policy and confirm in writing that no patient is turned away or delayed for a deposit.
law_line: Section 20 of the National Health Act 2014 forbids any provider from refusing emergency medical treatment for any reason.

ask_text: Publish your policy on unpaid bills and confirm in writing that no patient or body is held over a debt.
law_line: Holding a person over a debt engages the constitutional right to personal liberty.

ask_text: Publish how patients can report staff conduct safely, and how many conduct complaints were received and acted on this year.
law_line: The Patients' Bill of Rights guarantees treatment with respect and dignity.

ask_text: Publish staffing levels per shift for the affected departments and the plan to cover nights and weekends.
law_line: The Patients' Bill of Rights guarantees quality care and urgent attention when needed.
